title: THE FLAME OF OBSIDIAN // CITADEL OBSERVATORY
narrative: In the highest chamber of the Citadel, Archmaester Marwyn strikes steel to flint. The black obsidian glass candle ignites without a wick, casting a blade of razor-sharp green luminescence across the parchment maps. In the candle's flame, Sam sees Daenerys mounting Drogon in Essos, Jon Snow waking in a storm of crows, and Euron's fleet bathed in kraken blood. 'The Citadel's maesters built a world without magic,' Marwyn rumbles, strapping on his leather apron. 'Now the magic is breaking down the doors.'

options.text: Catch the novice Pate stealing the secret archmaester keys.
Descend into the forbidden vaults to retrieve the Death of Dragons manuscript.
